author: Opus 5.5 (Claude Code), max effort
science_guardrails: Ensign wasp: all black, small, flag-like flattened abdomen on a thin stalk set high on the thorax, long hind legs, clear wings; does not sting people.
One white wasp egg per egg case; the larva feeds on the cockroach eggs inside; first-instar jaws sharply pointed with a row of small teeth.
Pupa inside the case with no cocoon; the adult cuts a small round jagged hole near one end of a long side.
American cockroach: reddish brown, pale-yellow band round the pronotum edge, long wings, long antennae, spiny legs. Egg case purse-shaped, dark, ridged seam, 16 eggs in two rows.
Only the American cockroach is shown as a host; no claim about every species.
No treatment advice: no sprays, baits or traps. The flashlight is inspection only.
A wasp sighting is not shown as proof of an infestation.
No on-screen text other than captions.

shots.visual: Close profile of the black ensign wasp walking across the cabinet floor, its small flag-shaped abdomen bobbing on a thin stalk.

beats.action: Wasp mid-stride; a question mark pops above it.
Wasp stops; the flag-like abdomen flicks up.

shots.visual: The wasp stands on top of a dark, ridged cockroach egg case.
shots.camera: Whip back from the wasp to show the case under it, then push in.

beats.action: Pull back: the wasp is standing on an egg case.
Its abdomen tip bends down and presses on the case, wriggling.
A see-through circle opens on the case: one white egg pops inside.
The circle widens to show the egg inside among the rows of cockroach eggs.

shots.visual: Paper slide to a big American cockroach (reddish brown, pale-rimmed shield, long wings and antennae) with its egg case at the tip of its abdomen.
shots.camera: Wide, then push to the egg case.

beats.action: Cockroach slides in, walking, antennae sweeping.
Camera pushes to the egg case at its tail; lime ring.

shots.visual: The egg case sits on the floor; a question mark beside it.
shots.camera: Slow push in on the case.

beats.action: The case drops to the floor with a bounce; a question mark pops.

shots.visual: Scale: the tiny wasp next to the egg case and the huge cockroach.
shots.camera: Starts tight on the wasp, fast pull back to the wide comparison.

beats.action: Fast pull back: the wasp is tiny beside the roach.
Lime ring pops round the small wasp; its abdomen bobs.

shots.visual: Portrait of the wasp; a purple paper pennant on a pole appears beside its abdomen and waves with it.

beats.action: Cut to the wasp portrait, antennae waving.
Ensign (flag) pennant pops up beside the abdomen; both wave together. Symbol for the name.
Pennant flips away; the abdomen bobs up and down twice.

shots.visual: The wasp braces on the egg case and presses its abdomen tip into the case wall.
shots.camera: Medium on the case, push in.

beats.action: Wasp presses its abdomen tip to the case, wriggling.
See-through circle: ONE white egg slides in; lime ring.
The egg glints.
Circle widens: the egg is inside, among cockroach eggs; the wasp walks off.

shots.visual: Inside the opened case: two rows of pale cockroach eggs and the wasp egg on top.

beats.action: The wasp egg wobbles.
It splits; a tiny pale larva wriggles out.

shots.visual: The young larva close up: pale, legless, segmented, with small jaws.

beats.action: Larva wriggles, jaws working.
Lime ring round the young wasp.

shots.visual: The whole cutaway: a dozen or more cockroach eggs around the larva.
shots.camera: Pull back to the whole case.

beats.action: Pull back to the whole case.
Eggs light up one by one, twelve of them.
More light up: the back row too.

shots.visual: The rows of cockroach eggs; the larva turns to the nearest egg.
shots.camera: Pans along the egg row, then to the larva.

beats.action: Pan along the row of cockroach eggs.
All the eggs bounce.
Larva turns to the nearest egg and opens its jaws.
Chomp.

shots.visual: The larva crawls across the tops of the eggs.

beats.action: Larva wriggles forward.
It lifts its head toward us.

shots.visual: Head-on close-up: two sharply pointed, sickle-shaped jaws.

beats.action: Jaws snap open; the sharp points glint.
Jaws snap shut and open: a chomp with a small shake.
Camera slides toward one jaw.

shots.visual: The inner edge of the jaw, lined with a row of small teeth.

beats.action: Tight on the jaw edge.
The row of small teeth pops up one by one; a lime line runs along them.
Jaws open wide.

shots.words: cut through the shells of the
shots.visual: The larva bites into one cockroach egg.

beats.action: Jaws close on the egg shell: a cut appears.
The cut runs through the shell.
The shell collapses, empty.

shots.visual: Egg after egg around the larva is emptied.
shots.camera: Hops egg to egg, then pulls back.

beats.action: Hop to the next egg: it is cut and collapses.
Another egg collapses.
Pull back: eggs around the larva empty one after another.
The larva wriggles in the middle.

shots.visual: The larva feeds and grows inside the case.

beats.action: Fast chomping; nearby eggs empty.
The larva swells, growing until it nearly fills the case.

shots.visual: The larva becomes a pale pupa with the adult wasp shape, legs and wings folded, no cocoon; then a black adult.

beats.action: Squash-flip: the larva turns into a pale pupa.
The pupa starts to darken.
Pop: a black adult wasp, folded inside.

shots.visual: Pull back: the adult lies inside the same egg case, which closes up.
shots.camera: Pull back to the whole case.

beats.action: Pull back: the adult inside the case.
The cut-open side folds shut: the same case.
Lime ring round the case.

shots.visual: Inside view of the adult; it stirs and its legs and antennae unfold.

beats.action: The adult inside the case.
It stirs; legs and antennae unfold.
A shine sweeps across it: the change is complete.

shots.visual: Outside of the case, close on one end of a long side.

beats.action: The case trembles.
A chewed line starts round a small circle, crumbs flicking off.

shots.visual: The chewed circle near the end of the case completes and pops out.

beats.action: A small lime ring marks how small the circle is.
The chewed line closes into a round circle.
The disc pops out: a small round hole.

shots.words: through the case and comes out.
shots.visual: The adult wasp pushes out through the hole and climbs out.

beats.action: Head and antennae poke through the hole.
Pull back: the case with the wasp coming out.
The wasp pulls free and climbs down.
Outside, it lifts its flag-like abdomen and flicks its wings.

shots.visual: Looking down: an American cockroach scurries across the cabinet floor.
shots.camera: Top view; punch in on the pronotum.

beats.action: Cockroach scurries in from the corner.
Punch in: the pale-rimmed shield behind its head.

shots.visual: The egg case at the tip of its abdomen is left on the floor.
shots.camera: Pans down the body to the tail.

beats.action: Pan to the tail: its egg case.
The case is left on the floor; the roach scurries off.

shots.visual: Side view: the egg case on the floor; the wasp walks up to it.

beats.action: Cut: the case on the floor; the wasp walks in.
Lime ring round the case.
The wasp taps the case with its antennae; its abdomen bobs.

shots.visual: A lime target snaps onto the egg case.

beats.action: Lime target snaps onto the case.

shots.visual: Wide: the cabinet under a kitchen sink, with pipes, a crack in the floor and a gap under the back wall. Roaches move along the floor.

beats.action: A roach scurries in along the floor.
A second roach peeks from the gap.
The first roach stops; an egg case shows at its tail.

shots.visual: Close on the crack in the cabinet floor.

beats.action: The egg case is left at the crack and slides in.
Lime line traces the crack.

shots.visual: The small gaps: under the back wall and around the drain pipe.

beats.action: Whip to the back wall.
An egg case sits in the gap under the wall.
Lime traces the gap; a lime ring circles the gap round the pipe.

shots.visual: The hot-water line under the sink.

beats.action: A roach crawls toward the warm line, antennae waving.
Warm glow and heat ripples rise from the line.

shots.visual: The dripping drain trap and the damp floor.
shots.camera: To the trap, then pull back wide.

beats.action: Drops fall from the trap; a damp patch spreads.
Pull back: the warm, damp spot under the sink, roaches near it; a lime ring circles it.

shots.visual: The cabinet goes dim; a hand shines a flashlight in.

beats.action: The cabinet dims.
A hand with a flashlight slides in; the beam clicks on.
The beam swings to the crack.
The beam sweeps the gap and the damp corner.

shots.visual: The beam finds the egg cases.

beats.action: The beam settles on the crack.
The egg case in the crack glints.
Lime rings on the egg cases.

shots.visual: The beam finds a live roach at the gap.

beats.action: The beam swings toward the gap.
A live roach steps out into the light, antennae waving.
Lime ring round the roach; it freezes.
